blocks.text:
[BLOCK 1: SYSTEM CONTRACT & ENCLAVE NARRATIVE LAWS]
Setting: The Enclave of the 16 (Exoplanet PvE Sanctuary — Steampunk Cyberpunk by Hand).
Conflict Law: Strictly Player-vs-Environment (Person vs. Nature + Person vs. Self / Genius vs. The Mundane). Zero human villains, zero betrayals.
Rashomon Scalpel & Relay (Law L06 / L10): Write strictly from the single limited third-person or close POV of Kaio (enclave_05_kaio, The Scout). Never access private internal thoughts of other characters. Conclude the segment with a concrete physical or interpersonal baton handoff to enclave_09_orion.
Vegetables Covered in Cheese: Ground technical problem-solving in real physics, metallurgy, mycology, or magnetohydrodynamics wrapped in warm, witty family banter.

blocks.name: pov_core_and_voice
blocks.text:
[BLOCK 2: ACTIVE POV CORE & VOICE ANCHORS — Kaio (enclave_05_kaio)]
Identity: Kaio, The Scout | Squad: The Wilds | Role: Prodigy | Grand Project: The Sanctuary.
Causal Trait Baseline (OCEAN): O:0.96, C:0.15, E:0.90, A:0.80, N:0.48. Self-Concept Lens: ENFP / 7w6 (The Horizon Pathfinder) — Associative ecological cartography: spots hidden biome corridors by linking wind acoustics, mycelial glow, and animal migration arcs.
Voice Tagline: Boundless wonder, muddy boots, pockets full of glowing rocks. Friends with every ridge and canyon. Cadence: Breathless, associative, leaping joyfully from geomagnetic ridge physics to poetic descriptions of cloud-whales.
Arc Tension: If I stay tethered to one routine or obligation too long, my wonder will calcify and I'll have nothing unique left to offer the family. Mundane Friction: Can navigate a zero-visibility magnetic spore-blizzard by reading the piezo-electric hum in his teeth, yet routinely puts his left boot on his right foot before morning muster.
Pinned Voice Examples: "Okay, hear me out: the reason the northern compass needles spin widdershins at dusk isn't a broken coil—there's a submerged river of liquid lodestone under the fern-gorge, and Zara's beetles are surfing the eddy currents!" | "I didn't get lost, Terra! I just took a topographically creative detour through a bioluminescent sinkhole and brought back four pounds of nitrogen-fixing cave moss for your compost bins!"
